mapper.sql: SELECT ppb.branch_uuid FROM portfolio_projects pp JOIN portfolio_proj_branches ppb ON ppb.portfolio_project_uuid = pp.uuid JOIN portfolios portfolio ON portfolio.uuid = pp.portfolio_uuid WHERE portfolio.root_uuid = #{entityId}

SELECT project_branch.uuid FROM portfolio_projects pp JOIN portfolios portfolio ON portfolio.uuid = pp.portfolio_uuid JOIN project_branches project_branch ON project_branch.project_uuid = pp.project_uuid AND project_branch.is_main = ${_true} WHERE portfolio.root_uuid = #{entityId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM portfolio_proj_branches ppb WHERE ppb.portfolio_project_uuid = pp.uuid )

SELECT abp.project_branch_uuid FROM portfolio_references pr JOIN portfolios portfolio ON portfolio.uuid = pr.portfolio_uuid JOIN app_branch_project_branch abp ON abp.application_uuid = pr.reference_uuid AND abp.application_branch_uuid = pr.branch_uuid WHERE portfolio.root_uuid = #{entityId}

SELECT project_branch.uuid FROM portfolio_references pr JOIN portfolios portfolio ON portfolio.uuid = pr.portfolio_uuid JOIN app_projects app_project ON app_project.application_uuid = pr.reference_uuid JOIN project_branches application_branch ON application_branch.uuid = pr.branch_uuid AND application_branch.is_main = ${_true} JOIN project_branches project_branch ON project_branch.project_uuid = app_project.project_uuid AND project_branch.is_main = ${_true} WHERE portfolio.root_uuid = #{entityId}

sql.if: ( SELECT application_branch_uuid, project_branch_uuid FROM app_branch_project_branch UNION SELECT application_branch.uuid, project_branch.uuid FROM app_projects JOIN project_branches application_branch ON application_branch.project_uuid = app_projects.application_uuid AND application_branch.is_main = ${_true} JOIN project_branches project_branch ON project_branch.project_uuid = app_projects.project_uuid AND project_branch.is_main = ${_true} ) ab
